answers.puzzle_1_rating_reason: There were rows/columns that gave me enough hints to fill the whole row/column correctly. Afterwards filling in the rest was easy.
answers.puzzle_2_rating_reason: It was sightly harder than the first one. I had to think a bit more out of the box for this one.
answers.puzzle_3_rating_reason: I feel like this one did not have as good as hints as the first two. I also had to restart my puzzle, as it became messy.
answers.strategy: Some hints provided that the whole row/column must be filled out a certain way. When blocks were on the edge, I knew exactly how much to increase them. If I had to fill a line somewhere, I could use the max/min of its length to know where some blocks must be.
answers.comments: Keeping track of what has been filled out made things overall harder.
